source.revisionIdentity: Exact locally installed layer identified by SHA-256; no unverified upstream commit or current-upstream byte equivalence is claimed.

changes: Rasterized the complete original viewBox into an opaque PNG; no geometry rotation or crop.

Dimensions rounded from 2x source viewBox dimensions (2124.96 x 1070.34) to 2125 x 1070 pixels. Both normalized axes fill the PNG without letterboxing; aspect deviation from the vector is about 0.034 percent.
Replaced the source palette with explicit dark grayscale values for ground, trees, roads, buildings, floors, stairs, fences and rocks; composited transparency against #141414.
Omitted the source Sniper hazard annotation from the rendered PNG. No labels, objective/spawn markers or Arena area boundaries are baked into the texture. Original source remains unchanged.

calibration.imageCoordinates: Top-left origin; u increases right, v increases down. These are normalized image coordinates, not Unity bottom-left texture UVs.
calibration.scope: Horizontal XZ preview only; no world Y filtering. Reuse the selected ArenaAreaBounds.Outline at runtime; never maintain separate hand-drawn Arena geometry here.
calibration.acceptance: Derived from installed DynamicMaps bounds/rotation; native alignment at known Customs landmarks requires a GPU check before live acceptance.
